title: Releasing a return contract
statement: Given a return contract for a machine that starts and ends at an anchor state, with positive running time and no return to the anchor at any strictly intermediate positive time, the release machine has a contract starting in its initial release state and exiting at the anchor state in the machine-state summand. The released contract inherits the precondition, running time, endpoint (with its state mapped into that summand), and head-position bounds from the return contract.
hypotheses_covered: A return contract for the machine, anchor state, data type, and input
